en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with a paved road leading into a small village or farmstead. Wooden fences line the road and fields; scattered houses and farm buildings sit in gently rolling countryside bordered by forest. In the foreground a person or small vehicle is on the road. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small printer/photographer credit is at the bottom right.
